validation_checks.direction: Boundary-face exactification for the plastic constant
checks: Generate one frozen endpoint or cylinder family before inspecting the sampled values.
Fit one recurrence on a short prefix only once, then verify it on a much longer holdout.
Demand the same coefficients integrally and modulo 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, and 25.
Compare against random cylinders or interior faces of similar density.
validation_checks.failure_mode: If only random-looking cylinders work, or coefficients change after the holdout, the effect is post-selection rather than a genuine endpoint mechanism.

checks: Construct automata or transducers for the selector support in Dumont-Thomas numeration without using output data.
Check whether recurrence residual tuples have regular support on that selector.
Verify that the same construction fails for Salem and non-Pisot controls or for unrestricted support.
validation_checks.failure_mode: Regular addition alone is insufficient; if the Beatty relation itself remains unsynchronized on the restricted support, there is still no positive case.

checks: Compute e_k = shifted_LRS_k - floor(r * L_k) on 100+ terms for quadratic and cubic companion samples.
Test whether e_k is constant, eventually constant, or selector-constant on one frozen beta-cylinder or face.
Reject any selector whose e_k still takes both values infinitely often on holdout.
validation_checks.failure_mode: A bounded 0/1 cocycle with mixed support only explains near-recurrence, not exact recurrence.

checks: Translate each nested-floor branch into an explicit increasing index selector n_k.
Confirm that the resulting sequence is literally floor(n_k * r), not an iterated floor or auxiliary transform.
Cross-check that the selector belongs to the frozen family and is fixed before coefficient fitting.
validation_checks.failure_mode: If the branch needs adaptive decisions or nested floors in the value map, it does not answer the bottleneck.

checks: Freeze one coefficient vector and one burn-in from the first fit; never refit per modulus or per tail.
Require annihilation over the long holdout integrally and modulo 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, and 25.
Record the first failure window and classify prefix-only survivors as leaks.
validation_checks.failure_mode: Sparse selectors can fake exact recurrences for dozens of terms; without a frozen holdout and p^2 follow-up, the screen is too weak.

checks: Run the same frozen selector recipe on phi, sqrt(2), the plastic constant, one Salem control, and e.
Require a clean separation: quadratic or Pisot endpoint survivors persist, controls fail sharply.
State theorem language only for what the frozen panel actually separates.
validation_checks.failure_mode: If the same selector also produces long modular survivors for Salem or transcendental controls, H2 is not sharp enough.

checks: For arithmetic progressions and finite AP unions, distinguish ordered subsequence claims from set-cover or partition identities.
Require exact recurrence of the ordered values, not merely near-linearity of the set.
Use the existing plastic smoke cases as adversarial regression tests.
validation_checks.failure_mode: Set/sequence confusion recreates the plastic union_mod3_01 false positive and says nothing about genuine recurrence survivors.
